# The ball cart that rolls beside the shooter (game bone `rack`): two slate A-frames joined by rails,
# small ink wheels, three balls on top and two below (ball orange, seams dark). Origin on the ground
# under its middle; 0.95 m long (X), 0.5 m deep. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Frame --base-color 0.5843 0.5725 0.5608 --no-slot
material new Wheel --base-color 0.1608 0.1529 0.1961 --no-slot
material new Ball --base-color 0.9176 0.4667 0.1882 --no-slot
material new Seam --base-color 0.3176 0.2392 0.2392 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name FA0 --size 1 --location -0.4500 0.1100 0.4500
scale 0.05 0.05 0.7720
apply --scale
set rotation 16.557 0 0.000
apply --rotation
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name FB0 --size 1 --location -0.4500 -0.1100 0.4500
scale 0.05 0.05 0.7720
apply --scale
set rotation 16.557 0 180.000
apply --rotation
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name WA0 --size 1 --location -0.4500 0.2200 0.0600
scale 0.0600 0.1200 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Wheel
add mesh cube --name WB0 --size 1 --location -0.4500 -0.2200 0.0600
scale 0.0600 0.1200 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Wheel
add mesh cube --name FA1 --size 1 --location 0.4500 0.1100 0.4500
scale 0.05 0.05 0.7720
apply --scale
set rotation 16.557 0 0.000
apply --rotation
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name FB1 --size 1 --location 0.4500 -0.1100 0.4500
scale 0.05 0.05 0.7720
apply --scale
set rotation 16.557 0 180.000
apply --rotation
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name WA1 --size 1 --location 0.4500 0.2200 0.0600
scale 0.0600 0.1200 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Wheel
add mesh cube --name WB1 --size 1 --location 0.4500 -0.2200 0.0600
scale 0.0600 0.1200 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Wheel
add mesh cube --name R0 --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.1000 0.6200
scale 0.9400 0.0500 0.0500
apply --scale
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name R1 --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.1000 0.6200
scale 0.9400 0.0500 0.0500
apply --scale
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name R2 --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.1600 0.3000
scale 0.9400 0.0500 0.0500
apply --scale
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name R3 --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.1600 0.3000
scale 0.9400 0.0500 0.0500
apply --scale
material assign Frame
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball0 --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location -0.3 -0.0 0.75
material assign Ball
active Ball0
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035"
material assign Seam
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball1 --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location 0.0 -0.0 0.75
material assign Ball
active Ball1
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035"
material assign Seam
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball2 --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location 0.3 -0.0 0.75
material assign Ball
active Ball2
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035"
material assign Seam
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball3 --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location -0.16 -0.0 0.41999999999999993
material assign Ball
active Ball3
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035"
material assign Seam
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball4 --segments 10 --rings 7 --radius 0.15 --location 0.16 -0.0 0.41999999999999993
material assign Ball
active Ball4
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.035 && pos.z > -0.035"
material assign Seam
mode object
select all
shade flat
export rack.glb
